id: title:frankh:remove fully rolled out logs settings retention flag

review.posthog_relevance: Removes gating for retention settings and tabbed view in the Logs settings and Storybook documentation, potentially permanently removing the tabbed view and retention settings UI.
review.reason: The chunk removes the `LOGS_TABBED_VIEW` and `LOGS_SETTINGS_RETENTION` feature flags and their associated conditional rendering and settings entries. This removes the gating mechanism for these features, potentially permanently removing the tabbed view and retention settings UI. This is a localized maintenance and behavior change.
review.uncertainty: The exact user-facing impact depends on whether the tabbed view and retention settings are still implemented elsewhere without the flag; the removal of the flag alone does not prove the feature is gone, only that the gating is removed.

observations.limitations: This chunk removes the LOGS_TABBED_VIEW feature flag and its associated conditional rendering, while retaining the tabbed content. This could indicate a permanent removal of the tabbed view or a transition to a different implementation. No score assigned.
